calls.title: GrowthBook <> Brightscout Handoff
calls.summary: The meeting centered on enhancing mobile website performance, targeting a mobile score of 45, while acknowledging external script constraints. Key discussions included the resolution of seven remaining bugs affecting site features, with a commitment from team members to reposition the cookie consent pop-up to avoid overlap with chat functionalities. The design system was reviewed for better Figma integration, emphasizing the organization of brand assets and components. Additionally, CMS best practices were highlighted, recommending archiving over deleting items to preserve URLs, along with the importance of 301 redirects for SEO. Training resources, including Webflow University and Loom videos, were shared to empower the client in self-managing their site effectively.
calls.keywords: Webflow, Design System, Mobile Performance, Bugherd, Component Management, Figma Transfer
